test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Presently the age of a father is 3 times the age of his daughter. After 10 years, his age will be twice the age of his daughter. Find the present age of the daughter.
solution:
Given:

Presently Father is 3 times the age of the daughter and after 10 years his age will be twice the daughter's age.

Calculations:

Let present age of the daughter be x and father's age be 3x.

According to question,

3x + 10 = 2(x + 10)

⇒ 3x - 2x = 20 - 10

⇒ x = 10

Hence, The daughter is 10 years old in present.
